question: Which country won the 15th Men’s Hockey World Cup-2023 title?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Germany**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Germany** won the 15th Men's Hockey World Cup-2023 title.
 
• The final match was held on January 29, 2023, in Bhubaneswar, India.
 
• Germany defeated Belgium in the final to clinch the title.
 
• This victory marked Germany's third Men's Hockey World Cup title.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Men's Hockey World Cup is an international field hockey competition organized by the International Hockey Federation (FIH).
 
• The tournament was first held in 1971 and is conducted every four years.
 
• India has hosted the Men's Hockey World Cup on multiple occasions, including in 1982, 2010, 2018, and 2023.
 
• Germany's previous titles were won in 2002 and 2006.
